test_case.test_name: Connector leaky sensor — retained controlled review-layer procedure
test_case.purpose: Verify the specified CDU connector leak sensor detects an approved localized connector stimulus, asserts the correct alarm/protective action, and returns to normal after safe cleanup and verified dryness.
required_package: CDU/connector physical identity and sensor zone/channel map
Vendor-approved simulator/test fluid, location/amount/dwell and containment
Electrical isolation, cleanup/dryness/inspection, re-energization and recovery
test_case.test_command: Identify CDU, connector, sensor zone/channel and nearby energized components; isolate and contain; qualified cooling operator uses a vendor-approved connector leak fixture/simulator or metered compatible fluid at the defined location; record sensor/SEL/alarm/action timing; remove/collect fluid with approved method; inspect and verify dryness/connector integrity; confirm deassertion and controlled recovery/final state.
test_case.expected_result: 1. Leaky sensor should record a warning or error message. 2. System should have correct behavior ex: shutdown in 1 min. 3. Sensor should recover after connector is dry.

safety_gate: Isolate dedicated system and use containment/PPE/ESD/qualified operator
Never spray uncontrolled water toward a live CDU connector
Prevent fluid migration into contacts or energized equipment; define hard aborts
Do not re-energize until approved dryness/contact inspection; no retry
expected_evidence: Cleanup, contact inspection and independent dryness record
Deassertion, recovery/final state and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: If the connector must remain energized for detection, engineering must provide a qualified low-risk fixture and isolation boundary; otherwise use the approved powered-down/simulated method and document coverage.
